post.summary: Show or Create Document Markup Downloadable PDF
post.description:
Find or Create Document Markup Downloadable PDF. Starts processing to create a downloadable PDF with markup. When completed, the same request will include a download URL for the PDF.
item_id, item_type, and attachment_id paramters are the same parameters included in the URL when viewing the attachment in procore.
Example: app.procore.com/161072/project/submittal_logs/document_viewer?attachment_id=43&item_id=42&item_type=SubmittalLog&project_id=161072

parameters.name: version_datetime
parameters.description: Optional ISO 8601 timestamp (UTC) used to retrieve the state of the document and its markup as of that point in time. Omit to retrieve the current version.

project_id.description: ID of the project that owns the item and its attachment.

item_id.description: The ID of the parent item this document belongs to

item_type.description: The type of the parent item this document belongs to (eg SubmittalLog)

attachment_id.description: ID of the ProstoreFile (attachment) being marked up. Matches the `attachment_id` shown in the document viewer URL.

200.description: Document Markup Downloadable PDF completed and download URL is included in the response.

id.description: ID of the Document Markup Downloadable PDF record.

error_message.description: Message describing a processing failure. Null for a completed PDF.

status.description: Processing state of the Downloadable PDF; always `completed` for this response.

url.description: Temporary download URL for the completed marked-up PDF. Fetch this URL to download the file.

pusher_message_name.description: Name of the Pusher message broadcast when this PDF's status changes. Subscribe to it to receive real-time processing updates.

202.description: Document Markup Downloadable PDF job has been created and is processing.

id.description: ID of the Document Markup Downloadable PDF record.

error_message.description: Message describing a processing failure. Null while processing.

status.description: Processing state of the Downloadable PDF; always `processing` for this response.

url.description: Download URL for the marked-up PDF. Null until processing completes.

pusher_message_name.description: Name of the Pusher message broadcast when this PDF's status changes. Subscribe to it to be notified when processing finishes and the download URL becomes available.

reason.description: A human-readable code providing additional detail on the cause of the error.

403.description: User does not have permission to view Document Markup Downloadable PDF

reason.description: A human-readable code providing additional detail on the cause of the error.

404.description: Document Markup Downloadable PDF not found

reason.description: A human-readable code providing additional detail on the cause of the error.

id.description: ID of the Document Markup Downloadable PDF record.

error_message.description: Message describing why vector processing failed.

status.description: Processing state of the Downloadable PDF; always `error` for this response.

url.description: Download URL for the marked-up PDF. Null because processing failed.

pusher_message_name.description: Name of the Pusher message broadcast when this PDF's status changes. Subscribe to it to receive real-time processing updates.

422.description: Error updating Document Markup Downloadable PDF

reason.description: A human-readable code providing additional detail on the cause of the error.

x-code-samples.content:
import http.client

conn = http.client.HTTPSConnection("api.procore.com")

payload = "{\"project_id\":0,\"item_id\":0,\"item_type\":\"SubmittalLogApprover\",\"attachment_id\":0}"

headers = { 'content-type': "application/json" }

conn.request("POST", "/rest/v1.0/document_markup_downloadable_pdfs/find_or_create?version_datetime=SOME_STRING_VALUE", payload, headers)

res = conn.getresponse()
data = res.read()

print(data.decode("utf-8"))
